label: Source support for WithheldGivingIsPowerOverEsse
note: This supplies a case of power to unmake by withholding the same giving on which the creature continues to depend. The type ranges over any y and x with GivesTo at w and an accessible world where y exists without GivesTo. For each such pair, show that withholding the same giver’s contribution would terminate x’s being and so supplies PowerOver y x at esse. The article supplies neither the modal grounding of joint absence nor the transfer from collective power to each creature.
